pages.title: Valentina Castle in Ognyanovo Spa Resort
pages.description: Valentina Castle is situated in the village of Ognyanovo, which is one of the most popular Spa resorts in Bulgaria. The village is blessed with the gift of the natural springs with healing mineral water and is located in the lowland between four mountains, “Pirin”, Rhodope Mountains, “Slavyanka” and “Sturgach”. Valentina Castle, is open for visitors since 2016 and is the ideal place for  relaxation.

Something big is coming.
A new outdoor pool. A new relaxation zone. A lobby bar and a cigar bar. A children s area and a space for teenagers. A renovated restaurant and indoor pool. And 40 new rooms, each with its own character.
Valentina Castle, like you ve never seen it before.
Follow us — you don t want to miss this.
Valentina Castle – The Castle Above Four Mountains Marchevo village, Golek area | near Ognyanovo
There are places where time moves slower.
Valentina Castle stands on a hill in the Golek area, between Marchevo village and the renowned mineral spa resort of Ognyanovo — the place where Pirin, the Rhodopes, Slavyanka and Stargach are all visible at once. A mineral spring rises beneath the castle. Around it, forest. At night, the sky here is full of stars.
Rooms & Cottages 17 rooms, 3 suites and 6 eco cottages built from stone and wood — for two, for a family, for people who need a real rest.
The Warm Water The pools are fed by a local mineral spring — the same water that has made Ognyanovo famous for generations. A year-round outdoor aquatonic mineral pool, an indoor pool of 10 by 15 metres, indoor and outdoor jacuzzis, sauna, steam bath, heated sun loungers.
Evenings on the Terrace When the sun sets behind Pirin, the castle terrace becomes the finest spot in the area. Regional cuisine, wine, a star-filled sky undimmed by city light. Dinner here is never rushed.
Around Us Less than an hour from the castle lie places most people never find:
Kovachevitsa — an architectural reserve and the backdrop of dozens of Bulgarian films. Streets where five centuries of history are literally beneath your feet.
Dolen — a village where time stopped in 1460. Over 70 preserved Rhodope houses, narrow cobbled lanes, silence. Listed by UNESCO for its traditional high singing.
The Thracian Sanctuary near Gradishte — 7,000 years old, among rocks shaped like serpents and tortoises. Locals believe it carries a particular energy. Whether or not you share that belief, the stillness of the place is undeniable.
The Animal Park in Dabnitsa — camels, llamas, alpacas, deer. For the children. And honestly — for the adults too.
Come Whenever You re Ready The castle is open all year. Autumn turns the mountains rust and gold. Winter brings silence and frost on the windowpanes. Spring smells of resin and the first flowers on the slopes. In summer, guests fall asleep with the windows open and wake up with the mountain in the room.
